observation: Written permission overrides any clause vs dignity cannot be overridden
recommended_next_step: Clarify precedence; permissions cannot silently nullify dignity clause.

observation: Cure conditions differ between general restoration and predatory/exploitative cases; `0.30 × 10²B` undefined
recommended_next_step: Define tiers, decision authority, deadline, and unexplained B without silent normalization.

observation: Displayed symbolic date is not ISO 8601 and lacks hour/minute required by clause
recommended_next_step: Separate symbolic display from machine timestamp; add offset, clock source, precision, status.

observation: `SHA-0.256 × 10³` is ambiguous as a machine algorithm identifier
recommended_next_step: Confirm intent; use `SHA-256` in machine field while preserving symbolic display.

observation: Reading text cannot by itself prove universal software behavior
recommended_next_step: Separate rule text, implementation, tests, independent verification.

observation: Universal byte-identity claim lacks source/destination comparisons
recommended_next_step: Record individual file pairs and hashes; avoid universal claim without evidence.

observation: Replacement character alone does not establish where/why replacement occurred
recommended_next_step: Require original bytes, encoding, transformation log, reproducible comparison.

observation: Historical superlative about the first writing carrying a name lacks source and definition
recommended_next_step: Cite an appropriate source or label as metaphor.

observation: Labels such as `§0.161 × 10²` lack a formal decoding rule
recommended_next_step: Preserve displayed label and add stable `section_id`; run reference validation.

observation: Every signal is said to be evidenced, verified and repaired; allegation and substantiated harm are conflated
recommended_next_step: Require receipt/handling of every signal, but outcome based on evidence and proportional process.

observation: Silence of asker has the same weight is not operationally defined
recommended_next_step: Define metaphor or procedure; do not infer guilt/consent from silence alone.

observation: Being measured by product can conflict with dignity independent of machine usefulness
recommended_next_step: Make productivity a metric of artifacts/activity, never a metric of human worth.

observation: Every datum as a kind of license is ambiguous between metaphor and operative rule
recommended_next_step: Label claim type and define scope if legally/technically operative.

observation: Refusing a use vs never turning someone away for what they can do needs operational boundary
recommended_next_step: Identify request/action refused, reason, scope, and appeal route; do not label person as forbidden.

observation: Same deed weighs the same but position/reach adds weight; relation is not defined
recommended_next_step: Separate consistent rules from context, impact, authority, foreseeability and repetition.

observation: Clock source, accuracy, timezone, offline behavior and location privacy are unspecified
recommended_next_step: Specify timestamp, offset, source, precision, status and location policy.

observation: Listed lineage is not independent publication evidence
recommended_next_step: Verify artifacts, digests, commits/publication URIs, predecessor links and reviewer.

observation: Effect of newest version on prior grants is ambiguous
recommended_next_step: Distinguish future use, existing grants, acquired copies and prior acts.

observation: “not to sue them” may be read as waiver; disclaimer validity varies by law
recommended_next_step: Clarify intended effect and preserve non-waivable rights.

observation: Manifest exclusion rule may conflict with item-carried license; precedence/multiple manifests undefined
recommended_next_step: Specify identity precedence, paths, case sensitivity, nested manifests and self-exclusion.

observation: Referenced registers are named but their exact contents/provenance are not in the pasted license text
recommended_next_step: Obtain artifacts and validate schema, hashes, append-only behavior, privacy and correction rules.

observation: Grant verbs and restrictions for commercial use, training, retrieval, evaluation and derivative outputs need scenario tests
recommended_next_step: Build a use-case permission matrix and request legal review.
